answer: Epochal Vertex Anchoring: each epoch, an agent’s behaviour graph is hashed into a vertex; a comet tail of prior vertices must remain reachable via a vine of consistent neighbour endorsements. Cross-epoch, the new vertex must overlap ≥k neighbours with the previous tail, else trust decays. Sybils must sustain N distinct histories across epochs, costing correlated compute and graph maintenance linear in N, not one-off registration.
